name: Website
summary: How a whole AhaSlides website page is put together from the DS Marketing sections: every band is a shipped section, the sections keep the spacing and widths they ship with, the page has one H1 and one primary action per section, backgrounds follow the colour rules, imagery is real, the header is the product lockup, and the page is checked at three widths with only gentle motion. Each rule names the section, token or rule it comes from and the website judge criterion that checks it.
highlights: Every band is a DS Marketing section; a missing one is a DSN ticket, never hand-rolled
Sections keep their shipped rhythm: 96/64 px padding on desktop, 48/24 at 767 px, 32/16 at 479 px
One H1, one primary action per section, the hero's call to action repeated at the end
Checked at 1440, 768 and 375 px with no sideways scroll; motion is a gentle reveal at most
whenToRead: Read before building, redesigning or reviewing any website page made of full-width sections: a landing, pricing, blog, careers, campaign or help page, on the public site or inside the product.
lead: The Marketing section library gives you the bands; this pattern is how they go together into one page. It adds no new values: every number below is one the shipped sections already use (marketing/*.json), and colour and background come from the colour rules (brand/colour-rules.json, section 3), cited by id and not restated. Typography, UX writing, the page title and favicon, and the logo each keep their own guideline; judge a page on `website` plus `colour`, `background`, `typography` and `ux-writing`.

skillRef.note: The enforceable criteria are anti-slop/criteria.json surfaces.website (W1 to W9). Each rule below names its source (`source`): a Marketing section, a token or a colour rule.

surfaceChoice.useFor: the Navigation section (site header with <aha-product-lockup>), then one Header section: the page's only H1 and its primary call to action
surfaceChoice.example: Navigation, then a centred Header with Get started and Book a demo

surfaceChoice.useFor: Features, Numbers, Logos, Testimonials, Pricing and FAQ sections, in the order the story needs, each on its own band
surfaceChoice.example: Features alternating rows, then Logos, then Testimonials, then FAQ

surfaceChoice.useFor: the Footer banner, which repeats the hero's primary call to action, then the Footer
surfaceChoice.example: Footer banner Get started, then the Footer

surfaceChoice.surface: A band the library does not have
surfaceChoice.useFor: a DSN ticket for the missing section; never a hand-rolled band on the page
surfaceChoice.example: A comparison table section: file it, and ship the page without it or with an existing section

composedOf.use: the brand in the site header, as the Navigation section ships it
the primary and secondary call to action, at the xl height the sections ship
every icon on the page, by registry name
the vertical padding of a section on desktop
the side padding of a section on desktop, and the gap under a section heading
the vertical padding of a section at 767 px and below
the vertical padding of a section at 479 px and below
the side padding of a section at 767 px and below
the side padding of a section at 479 px and below
the pale pink (Vivid Pink at 5%) band, under colour rules 3.2 to 3.4
the duration of a hover or reveal transition

componentBacklog: No missing components. A band the Marketing library does not ship yet is a DSN ticket; add the section there before a page needs it.

rules.rule: Build every band of the page from a DS Marketing section: Navigation, Header, Features, Numbers, Logos, Testimonials, Pricing, FAQ, Footer banner and Footer (Cards inside a section). Paste the section's snippet and change its copy, images and layout choice, never its structure or values. A band the library lacks is a DSN ticket, never a hand-rolled section on the page.

Keep the section rhythm the sections ship: vertical padding `--aha-space-96` and side padding `--aha-space-64` on desktop, `--aha-space-48` / `--aha-space-24` at 767 px and below, `--aha-space-32` / `--aha-space-16` at 479 px and below. Sections sit flush; add no margin, spacer or divider between them.
source: marketing/testimonials.json — __inner padding and their 767 px and 479 px container rules

rules.rule: Cap section content at 1280 px, centred. Keep a section heading block to 720 px and its lead text to 44ch, as the sections ship them; never stretch body copy across the full width.

Give the page one H1, in the Header section at its display size. Each section has at most one primary button (colour rules 6.1 and 6.2); at most two buttons sit side by side, a primary and a secondary. The closing Footer banner repeats the hero's primary call to action.
source: marketing/hero.json and marketing/header.json — the h1 and the primary + ghost pair

rules.rule: Lay out band backgrounds by colour rules 3.2 to 3.5, 3.8 and 3.10: white by default, coloured bands are Vivid Pink or pale pink (`--aha-bg-accent`), a full white section always between two coloured bands, at most two Vivid Pink bands, the first screen white, no black band and no gradient. Light grey belongs to cards inside a section (the Cards gray variant), never a full band: no section ships one.

Use real `` elements with alt text for pictures: a product screenshot, a committed photo with its licence in the manifest, or the DS placeholder `marketing-assets/image-placeholder.svg` until one exists. No stock clip art, emoji used as icons, gradient blobs, glassmorphism or decorative 3D. Icons come from the registry by name with ``.
Use the Navigation section for the site header, so the brand is `<aha-product-lockup>`; the app-shell guideline's C1 owns that rule and is not repeated here.

Check the page at 1440, 768 and 375 px: no horizontal scroll at any width, multi-column sections stack to one column, and a stacked image sits on the same side of its text (above or below) in every section of the page. Calls to action keep the xl button height the sections ship; nothing you can tap is smaller than 24 by 24 px.
source: the sections' 991, 767 and 479 px container rules

rules.rule: Keep motion to what the sections ship: hover transitions and at most a gentle fade or slide on reveal, timed with `--aha-motion-*` and `--aha-ease-*`, and none under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. No parallax, no scroll-jacking, no autoplaying carousel or video; the Logos strip's shipped loop, which stops under reduced motion, is the one continuous motion allowed.
source: marketing/features.json — the video variant never autoplays
marketing/logos.json — the loop and its reduced-motion stop

reuseNote: Doc-only pattern: the DS ships the sections, not a page wrapper. A page is the sections' snippets pasted in order on one page that loads variables.css once; this pattern is the conventions plus the binary criteria (anti-slop/criteria.json, surfaces.website) a builder self-judges against.

selfCheck.label: every band is a DS Marketing section, none hand-rolled
sections keep their shipped padding at each width, with nothing between them
content capped at 1280 px; heading block 720 px; lead text 44ch
one H1; one primary button per section; at most two buttons side by side; hero CTA repeated at the end
band backgrounds follow colour rules 3.2 to 3.5, 3.8 and 3.10; no grey band
real images with alt text or the DS placeholder; registry icons; no clip art, emoji icons, blobs or glass
the site header is the Navigation section with <aha-product-lockup>
no horizontal scroll at 1440, 768 and 375 px; consistent stacking; targets at least 24 px
motion only on hover and a gentle reveal, off under reduced motion; no parallax or autoplay
